committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 11 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Raw paid clicks for the landing page test sit at 103, past the 75-click checkpoint, while creditRemainingExGst has hit A$0 and review_cta_click is still 0 since the test started on 6 Oct.

30-day impression share is only 10%, with 77.2% lost to rank against 14.5% lost to budget, and no external Google Ads changes were logged in the last 24 hours or 7 days, so the test numbers stay clean.

On the test page, ask_cta_click has reached 19 since start versus review_cta_click at 0, so visitors are using the quick question form (quick_question_click at 4) but nobody has taken the deeper booking step yet.

generate_lead shows 2 events since the test began against formStartsLast7 of 2 and leads.last7 of 1, each one an unverified enquiry Chris still needs to check against the qualified rule, not a confirmed lead count.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks have reached 103, past the 75-click flag: Chris should check the test log now, and if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries the campaign is red-flagged.

Credit remaining has dropped to A$0, triggering the decision point: pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review, and review_cta_click is still at 0 so that condition is not yet met.
generate_lead is at 2 since the test started: check the Formspree and Cal.com confirmation emails for source details and grade each one in the test log against the qualified rule.
Logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups are still an open item.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to match current site stats.
